requirement.statement: Kunun SHALL preserve ORM prefix annotations through exactly one KnKnot.NamedConf profile and SHALL reject the legacy marker-name-plus-Conf transport.

case.given: a datasource, class, Field, or typed Property has a matching ORM NamedConf prefix annotation
case.when: source is parsed and bound into the public Kunun type-system model
case.then: the matching NamedConf payload SHALL remain attached without creating a shadow entity or relation model

case.given: an ORM annotation encodes its profile in the marker name and payload in Conf
case.when: a public ORM profile or admission helper reads it
case.then: Kunun SHALL return a stable rejection diagnostic and SHALL NOT normalize it into the canonical model

case.given: an ORM NamedConf profile is attached to the wrong declaration kind
case.then: Kunun SHALL reject the profile, including relation on Field and field on Property

requirement.statement: Kunun public packages SHALL expose typed Property metadata for downstream ORM profiles and SHALL NOT expose or positively parse a detached ORM relation annotation descriptor.

case.given: the Kunun source tree and built public package artifacts
case.when: their annotation API surface is inspected
case.then: they SHALL NOT contain OrmRelationAnnotationProfile, ValidateDepaOrmRelation, or a positive detached ORM relation parser

case.given: generic relation NamedConf, generic annotations, and typed class Properties
case.when: the Kunun packages are parsed, bound, and typechecked
case.then: the generic relation payload SHALL remain attached to a typed Property without ORM-specific interpretation in Kunun core
